title: A run longer than the memory
hook: Fresh arrivals can extend a run or wait for the next one.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Freeze incoming items that are smaller than the last output to extend external-sort runs.

misconception: A memory of k items can never produce a sorted run longer than k.
objective: Freeze incoming items that are smaller than the last output to extend external-sort runs.

claims.text: An arriving key can extend the current run only if it is at least the last output. Smaller arrivals freeze for the next run, letting favorable input produce a run longer than the heap capacity.
